title: 第9章 唐家小家，宣布独立！
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚完结版免费阅读
content_zh: 颜霜玉气得胸口起伏。该死的，早知道应该说五百两了！谁能想到这废物，竟然能拿出这么多银子。“这……怎么可能？”唐画和唐浩也目瞪口呆。随即，两人眼中便升起了浓浓的贪婪。五百多两，这废物哪里来这么多银子？唐敬看到这一幕，就明白了偷钱是假，颜霜玉诬陷唐逸是真。他冷哼一声，颜霜立即玉努力挤出一个笑容，道：“老爷，你看我就说了嘛，应该是我记错了……”“你看，冤枉了小逸了吧？”话落，颜霜玉看向唐逸，笑道：“小逸，我和你道歉……”“道歉？免了，你不配！”唐逸拉着唐音，直接回了西院。他可没时间陪颜霜玉母子，玩这么弱智的游戏。听到唐逸的话，唐画唐浩脸色铁青，颜霜玉脸色也一阵僵硬，有些狰狞。该死的，你狂妄什么？别给老娘逮到机会，否则我饶不了你。“老爷，你看小逸……”颜霜玉抱着唐敬的手腕，想要撒娇，唐敬却已经甩开了她的手。“原来，你们还真的是在联手诬陷唐逸啊！”听到这话，颜霜玉和唐画兄弟，脸色顿时大变。“老爷……”颜霜玉下意识要解释，唐敬挥手打断：“诬陷就诬陷了，没什么大不了的。”“谁让你们，才是我最牵挂的人呢。”“当然，仅此一次，下不为例。”唐敬转身回了房间，只有冰冷的声音在大殿上传开。让站在院中的颜霜玉和唐家兄弟，如坠冰窟。“娘，大哥，爹这是什么意思？”许久，唐浩声音都带着一丝颤抖。“什么意思？重要吗？不重要！”唐画轻笑一声，道：“现在重要的是唐逸，五百两，他随随便便就能拿出来五百两，我怀疑，那贱人还给他们兄妹俩留有巨额财富。”“不，现在是我们的巨额财富了。”闻言，颜霜玉和唐浩的脸上，立即充满贪婪。之前接管唐家的时候，柳如玉留下来的财产，足足有五万两。五万两，让他们母子几人醉生梦死了三四年，现在已经挥霍完了。整个唐家，现在连两百两银子都拿不出来了。现在唐逸既然暴露了柳如玉留下来的财产，那还等什么？自然是想方设法将其弄到手啊！“画儿，已经有计划了吧？你想怎么做？”颜霜玉吟吟笑道，她儿子素来聪明，肯定有办法了。“很简单，等下我光明正大将他交出来，和他要。”唐画手落在唐浩的肩膀上，笑道：“小浩，哥是读书人，这事只能你来做。”“等下我拖住他，你从后院爬墙进去，将整个马桶房全部翻一遍。”“就算没有找到那贱人留下的财产，也要将唐逸手中那五百两偷出来。”“他手中没有银子，他才会想办法去动他娘留下的财富，届时我们只需要守株待兔，盯着他即可。”唐浩眼睛顿时亮了起来：“大哥高啊！”颜霜玉抬手揉了揉两个宝贝儿子，道：“行，那娘就等着你们的好消息了！那贱人留下的财产，一定是笔不菲的数目……”……唐府，西院。“哥哥，咱们辛苦赚的钱，差点被他们抢了，好过分！”唐音瘪着小嘴，很不开心，哥哥辛苦赚的钱，险些进了别人的口袋。“想多了，他们想要从哥哥这里抢钱，还早两万年呢。”唐逸揉了揉唐音的脑袋。“嗯，哥哥最厉害了。”唐音用力点头，她现在对哥哥已经是盲目的崇拜了。哥哥说能赚几百两银子，就轻松赚了几百两银子。他们想要抢哥哥的银子，做梦！“哥，好臭……”重新回到马桶房，习惯了一天新鲜空气的唐音，有点不习惯马桶房的臭味了。“简单，丢出去就是了！”唐逸盯着堆积如山的马桶眯起了眼睛：“现在开始，咱们打造一个属于咱们自己的小家，和唐家没有任何关系的小家。”前身受尽屈辱没有离开唐家，不是他不想离开，而是他很清楚离开了唐家，颜霜玉会更加肆无忌惮对付他们兄妹俩。离开唐家，他们会死得更快。唐逸不一样。他完全可以带着唐音离开。可凭什么？！唐家这一切，本来就属于前身的，他自然要帮其夺回来。逃兵？他唐逸这辈子最恨的，就是逃兵。听到唐逸的话，小姑娘立即就激动的跳了起来。唐逸还没发话，她放下新置办的衣服和被子后，一手提着一个马桶摇摇晃晃出了门，重重丢在外面。“我有哥哥就好了，我不刷了，爱谁刷谁刷去！”小手叉腰，那是一个霸气。就是瘦骨嶙峋，画面有点违和。唐逸也拎着两个马桶，直接砸了出去，冲着东院喊话：“不想唐家臭气熏天，把马桶和浸泡的衣服全部清理了。”“半炷香内不处理完成，后果自负！”兄妹俩双手叉腰，威风凛凛站在阳光下，向全世界宣布：唐家小家庭，正式宣布独立！很快，唐家管家便带着一群家丁和婢女，将马桶和衣服全部搬走了。重新回到小院，唐音手提扫帚开始扫地，唐逸则打水将院子里里外外全部冲了一遍。又将屋顶，床榻，桌子凳子全部修了一遍。直到入夜，整个马桶房终于焕然一新，不再臭气熏天了。为此，小姑娘还贴心将马桶房改成了小唐府，意味着他们兄妹俩组建的唐家，正式挂牌营业了。晚上，唐逸亲自下厨，给小姑娘烧了一桌丰盛的饭菜。然而。刚吃完饭，唐敬身边的小厮敲响了院门。“四少爷，老爷让你立即去书房，有你娘的事要和你说。”“好像是柳家那边，出事了。”唐逸原本不想理，但听到事关母亲和母亲的家族，他皱了皱眉，还是抱着唐音出了门。只是抵达东院唐敬的院子后，唐逸才发现唐敬书房的灯都没有亮。唐敬根本就不在家！唐逸脸色一沉，一脚将家丁踹翻在地。踩着小厮的脖子，唐逸一字一句道：“谁让你……骗我过来的？”小厮吓得脸色煞白，当场就招了：“四少爷饶命，是大少爷和二少爷，是大少爷和二少爷让小的带骗你过来的……”唐画和唐浩？上当了！唐逸脸色骤沉，立即快步往回走。刚回到西院，唐逸果然看到自己屋内被翻得乱糟糟一片，放在床板下面的银票，也不翼而飞……唐逸顿时攥紧拳，一股无名火直冲头顶：“唐画，唐浩！”刚刚冤枉他偷钱，现在自己先偷上了，狗东西，真特妈又当又立啊！“哥，我们的钱，钱不见了……”唐音瘦小的身影到处翻找，可找了一圈也不见银票，顿时小嘴一瘪，当场就哭了。那是她亲手藏的银票，现在竟然被唐画和唐浩给偷了。“音音不哭，哥哥向你保证，他们今天偷去的钱，哥哥一定会让他们跪着，十倍的还回来！”唐逸的声音中，隐隐爆发出杀意。
content_en: Yan Shuangyu's chest heaved with anger.Damn it, I should have said five hundred taels earlier!Who would have thought that this waste could actually come up with so much money."How... is this possible?" Tang Hua and Tang Hao were also stunned.Immediately, strong greed appeared in the eyes of the two people.More than five hundred taels, where did this loser get so much money?When Tang Jing saw this scene, he understood that stealing money was a lie and that Yan Shuangyu framed Tang Yi was true.He snorted coldly, and Yan Shuangyu tried her best to squeeze out a smile and said: "Master, you see, I just said it. I must have remembered it wrong..." "Look, I have wronged Xiao Yi, right?" After saying that, Yan Shuangyu looked at Tang Yi and smiled: "Xiao Yi, I apologize to you..." "Apologise? No need, you don't deserve it!" Tang Yi pulled Tang Yin and went directly back to the west courtyard.He didn't have time to play such a mentally retarded game with Yan Shuangyu and her son.After hearing Tang Yi's words, Tang Hua, Tang Hao's face turned livid, and Yan Shuangyu's face became stiff and a little ferocious.Damn it, what are you so arrogant about?Don't give me a chance, otherwise I won't be able to spare you."Master, look at Xiaoyi..." Yan Shuangyu held Tang Jing's wrist and wanted to act coquettishly, but Tang Jing had already thrown away her hand."It turns out that you are really working together to frame Tang Yi!" Upon hearing this, brothers Yan Shuangyu and Tang Hua's expressions suddenly changed."Master..." Yan Shuangyu subconsciously wanted to explain, but Tang Jing waved his hand to interrupt: "It's a false accusation, it's no big deal." "Who told you, you are the ones I care about the most." "Of course, this is just this time, it won't be the same next time." Tang Jing turned around and returned to the room, only a cold voice spread in the hall.Yan Shuangyu and the Tang brothers standing in the courtyard felt as if they had fallen into an ice cave."Mom, brother, dad, what do you mean?" Tang Hao's voice was trembling for a long time."What do you mean? Is it important? Not important!" Tang Hua chuckled lightly and said, "The important thing now is Tang Yi, five hundred taels. He can take out five hundred taels casually. I doubt that bitch left a huge wealth for the two brothers and sisters." "No, it is our huge wealth now." After hearing this, Yan Shuangyu and Tang Hao's faces were immediately filled with greed.When she took over the Tang family, Liu Ruyu left behind a fortune of fifty thousand taels.Fifty thousand taels, which kept the mother and son in a state of intoxication for three or four years, has now been squandered.The entire Tang family can't even afford two hundred taels of silver now.Now that Tang Yi has exposed Liu Ruyu's property, what are he waiting for?Of course I have to try my best to get it!"Hua'er, do you already have a plan? What do you want to do?" Yan Shuangyu said with a smile. Her son has always been smart and must have a way."It's very simple. I will hand him over to him openly later and ask him for it." Tang Hua put his hand on Tang Hao's shoulder and said with a smile: "Xiao Hao, I am a scholar, you can only do this." "I will hold him back later, and you can climb the wall from the backyard and search the entire toilet room." "Even if we don't find the property left by that bitch, we still have to steal the five hundred taels from Tang Yi's hand." "He.If he doesn't have money in his hands, he will find a way to touch the wealth left by his mother.Then we just have to wait and watch him." Tang Hao's eyes suddenly lit up: "Brother Gao!" Yan Shuangyu raised her hands and rubbed her two precious sons and said, "Okay, my mother is waiting for your good news!The property left by that bitch must be a lot of money..."...Tang Mansion, West Courtyard."Brother, our hard-earned money was almost robbed by them, that's too much!" Tang Yin pursed her lips, feeling very unhappy. My brother's hard-earned money almost went into someone else's pocket."Thinking too much, they want to steal money from my brother, it's still 20,000 years early." Tang Yi rubbed Tang Yin's head."Well, brother is the most powerful." Tang Yin nodded vigorously. She now worshiped her brother blindly.My brother said he could make hundreds of taels of silver, so he easily made hundreds of taels of silver.They want to steal their brother's money, dream!"Brother, it stinks..." Tang Yin returned to the toilet room. After getting used to the fresh air for a day, Tang Yin was a little unaccustomed to the smell of the toilet room."Simple, just throw it out!" Tang Yi stared at the piled toilet and narrowed his eyes: "From now on, let's build a small family of our own, a small family that has nothing to do with the Tang family." The predecessor suffered humiliation and did not leave the Tang family. It was not that he did not want to leave, but that he knew very well that after leaving the Tang family, Yan Shuangyu would deal with their brother and sister even more unscrupulously.If they leave the Tang family, they will die faster.Tang Yi is different.He could definitely leave with Tang Yin.But why?!Everything about the Tang family belonged to his predecessor, so he naturally wanted to help him get it back.deserter?What Tang Yi hated most in his life was deserters.Hearing Tang Yi's words, the little girl immediately jumped up excitedly.Before Tang Yi could say anything, she put down the newly bought clothes and quilt, staggered out of the door with a toilet in one hand, and threw it heavily outside."It's good that I have a brother. I won't swipe anymore. I'll swipe whoever I love!" He put his hands on his hips in a domineering manner.It's just that he's very skinny, and the picture is a bit inconsistent.Tang Yi also carried two toilets, smashed them out, and shouted to the east courtyard: "I don't want the Tang family to stink so much that I have to clean up all the toilets and soaked clothes." "If you don't finish processing the incense within half a stick, you will be responsible for the consequences!" The brother and sister stood majestically in the sun with their hands on their hips and announced to the world: The Tang family has officially declared independence!Soon, the Tang family's housekeeper took a group of servants and maids and moved all the toilets and clothes away.Returning to the small courtyard, Tang Yin started sweeping the floor with a broom while Tang Yi fetched water and washed the entire courtyard inside and out.The roof, beds, tables and stools were all repaired.Until nightfall, the entire toilet room finally looked brand new and no longer smelled bad.For this reason, the little girl also thoughtfully changed the toilet room into a small Tang mansion, which meant that the Tang family established by the brother and sister was officially open for business.In the evening, Tang Yi cooked a sumptuous meal for the little girl.However.Just after eating, the boy next to Tang Jing knocked on the courtyard door."Fourth Young Master, I want you to go to the study immediately. I have something to talk to you about your mother." "It seems that something happened with the Liu family." Tang Yi didn't want to pay attention at first, but when he heard that it was about his mother and her family, he frowned and still carried Tang Yin out of the door.It was only after arriving at Tang Jing's yard in the east courtyard that Tang Yicai discovered that none of the lights in Tang Jing's study were on.Tang Jing is not at home at all!Tang Yi's face darkened and he kicked his servant to the ground.step on
title_en: Chapter 9 The Tang family declares independence!
